An [[astromech droid]] '''pilot''' operated a [[Unidentified landspeeder (droid)|landspeeder]] on the [[planet]] [[Pagodon]]. The [[droid]] was signaled by a [[Kubaz]] [[Unidentified Kubaz ferryman|ferryman]] to escort [[Din Djarin]] and a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] to the ''[[Razor Crest]]'', but Djarin refused.<ref name="Chapter 1" />
